description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). End-of-life Tracker: published end-of-support and end-of-life dates for open-source software and OS release lines (e.g. ubuntu/24.04, python/3.12, kubernetes/1.31). Raw readings first: each date carries its source URL and retrieval timestamp; confidence reflects how many independent sources agree. Primary source endoflife.date (MIT); second sources where cleared. Unknown models get an error before payment (nothing charged). Go dates, when present, are labeled modeled. JSON. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

model.description: Product/cycle id, e.g. ubuntu/24.04 or python/3.12 (slash allowed)

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_end_of_support
title: End-of-life Tracker (open-source) (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
